summary.text: Phil Pouech, a Democrat from Hinesburg, has represented Chittenden-4 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2023.
He is the ranking member of the House Committee on Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Pouech was born in 1957 and has a bachelor's degree in Environmental Science from Unity College in Maine, with a focus on renewable energy, according to his House biography.

He worked for 40 years in high-tech manufacturing, including engineering, environmental and safety roles and management, and spent the last 18 years of his career with Vermont companies manufacturing solar and wind energy products.
He moved to Hinesburg with his family and has lived there for over 35 years.

He coordinated Hinesburg's Green Up Day for over 20 years and, after graduating from the Vermont Leadership Institute in 2011, was elected to the Hinesburg Selectboard, serving 12 years including five as chair.
He is also a commissioner on the Green Mountain Transit Board.
